_readme: Edit this file to change the plan. Weeks run Mon-Sun from start. mi is the planned distance used for chip sizes (a range uses its midpoint); miText is what the chip shows. role is Key, Long, Race, Supporting, Optional, or Rest. keyMin is the key session's own minimum vert in feet. vertLo and vertHi are the weekly vert target. Long is the long run, and Race is the long run in week 17. Run node scripts/training/build-training.mjs after editing.
